name: Standard Digital Wallet Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent access to digital wallets: balance reads, transfers with amount/recipient bounds, and history queries. Any wallet backend can implement this contract through an adapter.
author: varwof (open ecosystem)

capabilities.description: Read wallet balances for authorized assets/networks
capabilities.summary: Query balance of authorized assets on authorized networks
capabilities.usage: Agents that need to check funds before proposing actions
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted when the agent should not know balances

capabilities.description: Transfer funds within amount, recipient, asset and network bounds
capabilities.summary: Send authorized assets to allowlisted recipients, bounded per transaction
capabilities.usage: Agents that pay invoices, refunds, or bounties on behalf of the principal
capabilities.when_not: High-risk: never without amount/recipient/asset bounds; recipient allowlist required

capabilities.usage: Agents that reconcile payments or report spend
capabilities.when_not: Not needed for agents that only initiate payments
